bullets.text: Premier League Streaming Options - Arsenal faces Brentford in a crucial London derby, available on **TNT Sports** in the UK.
Samsung Galaxy S26 Rumors - Pre-orders may include a free storage upgrade, despite pricing concerns.
England Rugby's Tech Boost - **Apple** showcases how iPads and Macs enhance live match analysis for the England Rugby team.
Ring's Controversial Feature - The new **Ring Search Party** feature faces backlash over privacy concerns amid surveillance fears.
Rivian's Apple Watch Integration - A new app will allow **Rivian** owners to control their vehicles directly from their Apple Watch.
Waymo's Door Issue - **Waymo** asks DoorDash drivers to help close doors on its self-driving cars, highlighting operational quirks.
Spotify's AI Revolution - **Spotify** claims its top developers haven't coded since December, thanks to AI assistance.
Aurora's Driverless Trucks - **Aurora** achieves a milestone with its trucks traveling 1,000 miles faster than human drivers.
Apple's iTunes Changes - **Apple** is set to remove the iTunes Wish List feature, urging users to migrate their selections.
New MacBook Rumors - A new **MacBook** is expected soon, featuring a smaller display and an iPhone-class chip.
